notes: Assistant lives under More → Assistant with tabs Chat, Feedback, AI Settings, Logs (no FAB).

Global Presence (2.3.0): Hubs can register themselves with optional directory seeds so people find each other by name/account without bulk sync of all posts. Content is loaded on demand when you open a profile.
Presence is off by default when no PRESENCE_SEEDS are set; the Hub stays fully local and works offline.
Host port for SoloHost public links defaults to 28090, not container 8080.
Direct messages are not available. Group and followers-only posts stay on this Hub.
External AI is optional and quota-limited; offline guide always works.
Remote /api/remote/info is owner-only; anonymous callers cannot learn public IP.
Chunked upload: POST /api/media/sessions → PUT chunks → POST complete (5 MiB parts).
Link embeds: YouTube/Vimeo safe iframes; other links use SSRF-safe unfurl previews.
Federation: hello can use Host-derived endpoint; /connect and /inbox support NAT push.
Bulk content sync between trusted peers is opt-in (content_sync = trusted); default is off to save bandwidth and storage.
Backup uses consistent SQLite VACUUM INTO snapshot so WAL pages are not lost.
